senses.gloss: growth, that which advances growth, sanitary treatment.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 78b:7">Yoma 78ᵇ</cite> <he>רְבִיתֵיה דינוקא וכ׳</he> the proper treatment of a child consists in (bathing in) warm water and (rubbing with) oil.

<cite ref="Yoma 78b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>הנך דלאו רְבִיתַיְיהוּ</he> (some ed. <he>רְבִיתַיְהוּ</he>) those things (as wearing shoes) which have nothing to do with their healthy growth; <he>הנך דרביתייהו וכ׳</he> those other things (as ointing) which are needed for their health &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 46b:12">Ḥull. 46ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>היינו רביתייהו</he> this position of the adhering lungs (one overlapping the other) is the means of healing; v., however, <cite ref="T00115">next w.</cite>
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:1:3">Y. Keth. V, beg. 29ᶜ</cite> <he>אשכח גידול ר׳ ומר וכ׳</he> G. found something great and reported something small.
